post.description: Start a guided voice intake. Works before sign-in, like the typed form.
One turn: audio (or typed text) → transcript → slots → localized reply (+ audio URL).
Summary of the application in the applicant's language, to be read aloud before submit (C6).
"haan, sahi hai" confirms (text evidence goes into the consent record); naming a field asks to correct it.
Order the schemes the rules found eligible, with plain-language reasons. Never adds or removes a scheme.

get.description: Files sent to this lender. Admins see all lenders (read-only for decisions).

post.description: Verify the signed QR from the citizen's phone or loan file, then open that file.

receive · start_review · request_documents · approve (sanction letter) · reject (coded reason) · disburse.
Status push and SMS in the applicant's language go out when this commits (claim C21: the lender decides).
